metadata.description: God Mode skill collection for Claude Code

plugins.name: god-mode
plugins.description: Core: router, rules, token protocol, first-run category picker. Install this one.

plugins.name: gm-web-design
plugins.description: Web & Design: Copy a website you like into a Next.js project, recolor a design image with a new palette, and get a scored review of a site or dashboard on a phone.

plugins.name: gm-qa-audit
plugins.description: QA & Audit: Test a mobile app before you publish it, or find out why a website is broken or slow, with a backup and rollback for every fix.

plugins.name: gm-seo-writing
plugins.description: SEO & Writing: Get found on Google and in AI answers, and make AI-sounding text read like a person wrote it.

plugins.name: gm-video
plugins.description: Video & Marketing: Turn a product or a raw recording into a promo film, a trailer or vertical shorts with captions, plus the post and store text to go with it.

plugins.name: gm-career
plugins.description: Career: Fix your CV and LinkedIn for ATS, check which jobs you really fit, and get a tailored CV and application drafts for each one. You send them.

plugins.name: gm-automation
plugins.description: Automation & Agents: Pull data from a website without scraping the page, and hand a big task to a manager agent that splits it across specialists.

plugins.name: gm-study
plugins.description: Study: Upload a lecture and get one printable PDF: mind maps, diagrams, exam traps and a question bank with answers.

plugins.name: gm-interior
plugins.description: Interior Design: Plan a room from your photos and measurements: layout, furniture, lighting, a bill of quantities and a mood board.
